scope: Local Ed25519/canonical report and private temporary journal tests using synthetic RPC fixtures. No real-ledger observation, production reviewer roster or signing service.
checks: Three distinct selected keys in fixed five-key roster authenticate domain-separated canonical review reports
Forgery, substituted/duplicate signatures, wrong purpose/roster and changed original operation/policy/accounting digests reject
Stale/future reports, noncanonical schemas, unsafe contexts and fractional unit encodings reject
Combined expiry review rejects present receipts, finalized signature, missing history, changed obligations or later finalized journal
Caller roster/report/accounting mutation across await cannot change selected review inputs
Original journal remains unchanged and second handoff/retry/refund/reset/settlement/production controls stay disabled
coverageLimits: Distinct authenticated keys do not prove distinct operators or truthful observations
Programme/accounting digests are signed bindings, not independent chain/economic/history proofs
No real verifier deployment, signer custody, manual recovery approval or competing fork test
All synthetic private ledger attempts remain preserved; no new transactions or nonce use
Full-validator hosting, independent operators, funded backing and external review remain open
